Description: Susceptible individuals become exposed through contact with infectious individuals.
A proportion of infectious individuals are admitted to ICU.

Name: β
Description: Transmission rate, the rate at which new infections take place given a contact

Name: π
Description: Susceptibility, proportion of the population who is initially susceptible

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential growth rate, the rate at which the compartments E, I grow

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial distribution

Name: p_ICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection

Name: σ2_ICU_E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission
